scripts.build: tsup src/main.ts src/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron --sourcemap --clean
scripts.prepare:resources: pnpm --filter @pcc/web build && pnpm --filter @pcc/daemon build:desktop && node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs
scripts.package: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:resources && electron-forge package
scripts.make: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:resources && node scripts/make-windows.mjs
